Additional workflow · Section 4.3

LAMAR region selection and cytidine ranking

SVG · PNG · PDF
Icon preview Open full size ↗

The current application links Stage I region selection to Stage II ranking. Stage I outputs a probability of at least one RNA-seq-supported site; Stage II outputs a scalar editing-associated score. The design uses 1,024-nt windows with 128-nt overlap, although the evaluated data also include shorter regions. The reported Stage II evaluation scored cytidines in positive regions directly; the combined application is not presented as an evaluated end-to-end cascade.
